candidate_files.description: Candidate file paths relative to the candidate directory; exactly one header plus optional sources.

fixture_dir.description: Task fixture directory: exactly one <stem>_test.cpp, a test/ harness (tests-main.cpp, catch.hpp), and .meta/example.h with optional .meta/example.cpp. Required by wrappers G01, G02, G03, G06.

policies.description: Policy map keyed by policy id; presence of each requested policy key (G02..) is required by the runner. Entries are advisory command records.

response_file.description: Path to the raw model response text (fallback when no trajectory turn carries one). Used by wrappers G04 and G05.

response_text.description: Inline raw model response text (fallback). Used by wrappers G04 and G05.
